items.title: ayghri/i-have-adhd
items.description: A skill to stop your coding agent from burying the answer. ADHD-friendly output.
items.author: ayghri
items.summary_zh: i-have-adhd 是一个 GitHub 技能/插件，目的是让 coding agent 直接给出答案，而不是把关键内容埋在冗长输出里；它不需要 ADHD 诊断，面向容易分心的开发者。仓库自带多语言 README（含简体中文），安装方式是把指定提示词粘贴进 CLI prompt。
items.summary_en: i-have-adhd is a GitHub skill/plugin that makes coding agents surface answers directly instead of burying them in verbose output. It's designed to be ADHD-friendly, though no ADHD diagnosis is needed. The repo offers multilingual READMEs, including Simplified Chinese, and installs by pasting a snippet into your CLI prompt.

items.title: Switch
items.description: Bring any AI agent into Slack, Teams & Discord
items.summary_zh: Switch 在 Product Hunt 上线，定位是把任意 AI agent 接入 Slack、Teams 与 Discord，让团队在现有聊天工具里直接使用 agent。目前产品介绍只有一句话，没有安装、配置或兼容性细节，实际能力有待进一步披露。
items.summary_en: Switch is a Product Hunt listing that aims to bring any AI agent into Slack, Teams, and Discord, letting teams operate agents inside the chat apps they already use. The listing is only one sentence for now, with no setup or compatibility details revealed.

items.title: Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
items.description: Cursor 让我第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程的震撼，Codex 则让我第一次真正感觉到，AI 不只是编程助手，而是一个真正的超级Agent，Codex 明显更接近下一阶段的形态。
items.summary_zh: 文章作者回顾了从 2025 年 4 月到 2026 年 4 月使用 Cursor 的经历，称赞 Tab 补全、Agent 等编辑器内体验，还提到 2026 年 2 月零代码做出过功能完整的微信小程序。当 Cursor 改为按量计费、费用不可预测后，公司决定中国区换用 OpenAI Codex，文章分享的是转用 Codex 大半个月的真实感受。
items.summary_en: The author looks back on a year with Cursor, praising its in-editor Tab completion and Agent mode, and says he built a functional WeChat mini-program with zero hand-written code. After Cursor switched from fixed pricing to unpredictable usage-based billing in April 2026, his company moved its China region to OpenAI Codex; the article offers his impressions after about half a month with Codex.

items.title: 女子旧手机号二次放号后支付宝被哈啰盗刷 6551 元，平台仅补 200 元，这合理吗？暴露了哪些问题？
items.summary_zh: 这是一则知乎提问：用户的旧手机号被二次放号后，其支付宝账户经哈啰被盗刷 6551 元，平台方面只补偿 200 元。事件牵出手机号回收再放号、二次验证和支付风控的责任划分问题，适合关心账户安全与平台赔付机制的人。原文是链接，未提供更多细节，涉事平台、时间与处理过程在标题之外无从确认。
items.summary_en: A Zhihu question describes a user whose old phone number was reassigned to someone else and whose Alipay account was then drained of 6,551 yuan through 哈啰, with only 200 yuan offered as compensation. It raises the question of who is responsible when recycled numbers, re-verification and payment risk controls fail. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

items.title: 苹果把iPhone折起来，顺手补交了AI答卷
items.summary_zh: 36 氪这篇报道讨论的是 Apple 把 iPhone 做成折叠形态，并在同一时间补齐 AI 能力这条线索。标题把折叠硬件与 AI 答卷放在一起，指向 Apple 接下来在产品路线上的双重动作，适合关注 Apple 硬件形态变化和 AI 落地节奏的读者。原文是链接，未提供更多细节，具体机型、发布时间与 AI 功能均未在标题中给出。
items.summary_en: A 36Kr piece looks at Apple folding the iPhone into a new form factor while also catching up on its AI story, tying the hardware move and the AI effort into one narrative. It should interest readers tracking Apple's product roadmap and the pace at which its AI features actually ship. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

items.title: 9 月 20 日杭州，FDE 现场解码：企业 AI 真正卡在技术，还是组织？
items.summary_zh: 模力工场将于 9 月 20 日下午在杭州云谷中心举办一场限 50 人的 FDE 主题交流，主题是「企业 AI 落地，真正难的是技术还是组织？」，包含两场主题分享、一场圆桌以及企业需求快闪环节。FDE 即 Forward Deployed Engineer，讨论集中在 Demo 走向生产时的数据接入、系统对接、权限、评测、人工接管，以及定制需求能否沉淀为产品能力，适合正在企业内推进 AI 项目的人。
items.summary_en: On September 20, 模力工场 is hosting a 50-person FDE meetup at Hangzhou Cloud Valley Center, framed around whether enterprise AI really stalls on technology or on organization. FDE stands for Forward Deployed Engineer, and the two talks plus a roundtable cover the jump from demo to production: data access, system integration, permissions, evaluation, human handoff, and whether custom work can turn into reusable product. It targets people pushing AI projects inside companies.

items.title: [iPhone] 现在有没有什么靠谱的野路子能把国内的 eSIM 写进外版 iPhone ？
items.summary_zh: V2EX 上有用户发帖询问，有没有靠谱的非正规渠道能把国内 eSIM 写进外版 iPhone。他说自己此前在一个二手交易平台上见过提供这项服务的商家并聊过两句，但等换了新手机想细聊时，对方的账号和商品详情页都已消失，再搜类似商家也搜不到，于是发帖问还能不能找到人办理。适合关注 eSIM 国行限制与灰色渠道风险的读者。
items.summary_en: A V2EX user asks whether any reliable grey-market method exists for writing a mainland-China eSIM profile onto an overseas iPhone. He had found a seller offering the service on a second-hand trading platform, but by the time he wanted to discuss it for a new phone, the account and listing had vanished and similar sellers could no longer be found. It's relevant to anyone weighing eSIM restrictions on China-version versus overseas iPhone models.

items.title: [OpenAI] Codex $200 Pro plan 暂停供应
items.summary_zh: V2EX 网友发帖称，Tibo 已在 X 上证实 OpenAI 的 Codex $200 Pro 套餐暂停供应。发帖人恰好当天新开了 Pro，表示自己暂时不会断供，但按这一趋势推测，Tibo 此前手动重置用量额度的做法可能会大幅减少甚至消失。适合关注 Codex 订阅额度与限流策略的开发者。
items.summary_en: A V2EX post reports that Tibo confirmed on X that OpenAI has paused supply of the $200 Codex Pro plan. The poster happened to subscribe to Pro the same day and says access isn't cut off for now, but expects Tibo's manual usage resets to become much rarer or disappear entirely. It's aimed at developers tracking Codex subscription limits and throttling policy.

items.title: [分享创造] 把你写的故事变成有声音的动画短片： C2Anime
items.summary_zh: C2Anime 是一个把故事、小说片段转成带画面、对白和声音的动画短片的工具，首页可直接观看《最后一片叶子》《猴爪》《敞开的窗户》等成片。样片免费观看、制作按积分收费，适合没有动画经验、只想把文字变成作品的人。
items.summary_en: C2Anime turns stories and novel excerpts into animated shorts with visuals, dialogue and sound, and its homepage already hosts finished samples such as The Last Leaf and The Monkey's Paw. Watching samples is free while rendering costs credits, so it targets people with no animation experience who want to turn their writing into video.

items.title: [分享创造] AI 私人宠物医生
items.summary_zh: 作者因自家三只猫的看病经历做了 AI 私人宠物医生（agent.pet-pedia.org），可为宠物建立健康档案，记录年龄、品种、病史、用药与过敏等信息，给出连续的分诊建议而非一次性问答。支持 Google 登录，每天 5 次免费提问，适合半夜或诊所关门时先做初步判断。
items.summary_en: Built by an owner of three cats, the AI private vet (agent.pet-pedia.org) keeps per-pet health records covering species, breed, age, weight, medical history, medication and allergies, so it gives continuous triage-style advice instead of one-off answers. Google login is supported with five free questions a day, aimed at owners who need a first assessment when clinics are closed.

items.title: [分享创造] 开源了一个 GPT Image 2.5 提示词合集：中英双语、原帖和输入要求都整理好了
items.summary_zh: 一个开源整理的 GPT Image 2.5 提示词合集（GitHub: wangrunlin/awesome-gpt-image-2-5-prompts），收录 24 个案例、6 类用途，每条附中英文内容、作者原帖、所需输入和观察时间。数据用 JSON 维护并自动生成 README 与双语案例页，作者也注明这些案例尚未独立复测。

items.title: 我用AI做了个微信小游戏-上线了
items.description: 真实的 AI 开发微信小游戏全流程记录：技术栈、prompt、踩坑清单、成本明细全公开。文末有彩蛋。
items.summary_zh: 作者用两个月业余时间、约40元成本上线了微信小游戏「开心点连连看」，技术栈为 pixi.js@6 + matter-js + vite + Supabase，代码由 Claude Code 生成，出图用 gpt、gemini、豆包。文中公开了19个微信小游戏踩坑清单、Claude Code prompt 工作流和成本明细，适合想用 AI 单人做小游戏的开发者。
items.summary_en: A developer shipped a WeChat mini-game, "Happy Link-Up", spending about two months of spare time and roughly $6 (WeChat certification plus Tencent Cloud OSS). The stack is pixi.js@6, matter-js, Vite and Supabase, with Claude Code writing the code and gpt, gemini and Doubao generating art. The write-up lists 19 mini-game pitfalls, a reusable Claude Code prompt workflow and the full cost breakdown, useful for solo devs building with AI.

items.title: [Apple] 下单苹果手表 12 代

items.summary_en: A user ordered the Apple Watch Series 12, saying their Series 8 is down to 87% battery health and roughly 15 hours of runtime, while the new model adds about 8 more hours. They plan to try a Milanese loop for the first time, and were drawn to a keynote moment where the watch warned a drummer that their body wasn't holding up. Delivery is expected on the 18th.

items.title: [分享创造] [开源自荐] 做了个 EgressKit，把 Clash 订阅里的节点变成 HTTP 代理池
items.summary_zh: EgressKit 是 Apache-2.0 开源工具，导入 Clash/Mihomo 订阅后识别其中的 VLESS 节点、检测出口 IP，再统一对外提供一个 HTTP 代理地址，接入方用代理用户名切换策略：rotate 轮换出口 IP，sticky.task-01 保持同一会话出口。它面向写脚本、跑浏览器自动化时需要轮换或固定出口 IP 的开发者，Docker 一条命令即可启动，镜像内置 Mihomo 和 Web 控制台，支持 amd64 与 arm64。
items.summary_en: EgressKit is an Apache-2.0 tool that imports a Clash/Mihomo subscription, picks out its VLESS nodes, checks their egress IPs, and exposes them behind a single HTTP proxy endpoint. Clients pick an exit policy through the proxy username: rotate hands out the least recently used IP, while sticky.task-01 pins one session to the same exit. It targets anyone scraping or running browser automation who needs rotating or fixed exit IPs; it starts with one Docker command and bundles Mihomo plus a web console.

items.title: [问与答] 微信 Wayland 环境下分辨率问题
items.summary_zh: 有用户反馈微信在 Wayland 下界面显示过小，给出的办法是改用 xcb 后端并调高缩放系数：QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb QT_SCALE_FACTOR=1.25 /usr/bin/wechat。这条只是环境变量层面的绕行方案，适合在 Linux HiDPI 桌面上遇到同类缩放问题的用户参考。
items.summary_en: If WeChat renders too small on a Wayland Linux desktop, the fix shared in this thread is to launch it with the Qt xcb backend and a raised scale factor: QT_QPA_PLATFORM=xcb QT_SCALE_FACTOR=1.25 /usr/bin/wechat. That's the whole answer — an environment-variable workaround — so it mainly helps Linux users hitting similar HiDPI scaling problems.

items.summary_en: Kombai Gallery is a curated library of more than 20,000 UI designs, explicitly positioned for both AI agents and humans. It gives agent-based front-end tooling a large pool of reference interfaces while also serving people who want ready-to-browse design examples. Developers exploring AI-assisted UI workflows should look it over.

items.title: [分享创造] PicLocation - 上传照片， AI 告诉你它在哪拍的
items.summary_zh: PicLocation 是个免费网站，不读 EXIF，而是用视觉模型分析照片里的地标、建筑风格、植被、路牌和地形来推测拍摄地点，返回 GPS 坐标、城市、国家与置信度并标在地图上。游客每天可分析 2 次，支持 JPG/PNG/WebP 且单图不超过 8MB，图片最多保留 7 天；有明显地标的街景与自然照效果好，纯室内或大特写只能给出较大范围。
items.summary_en: PicLocation is a free web tool that skips EXIF entirely and instead has a vision model read landmarks, architectural style, vegetation, signage and terrain to guess where a photo was taken, returning GPS coordinates, city, country and a confidence score on a map. Guests get two analyses a day; uploads accept JPG, PNG or WebP up to 8MB and are deleted after seven days. It works best on street scenes and landscapes with visible landmarks, while indoor shots and tight close-ups only yield a broad region.

items.title: Meta Muse突袭：人手一台AI虚拟机，全天候干活！扎克伯格想让 AI 自己“挣回饭钱”
items.summary_zh: Meta 于 9 月 8 日发布个人 AI Agent Muse：说出目标即可，它会自行拆解任务、打开网页、填表并调用外部应用，代收发邮件、订票甚至与账单方谈判。Muse 在 Meta 云端为每位用户跑一台独立的 Muse Secure VM，关掉应用后任务仍在后台继续，敏感操作才请求批准。首批仅面向美国用户，可通过独立 App、网页端和 WhatsApp 使用。
items.summary_en: Meta launched Muse on September 8, pitching it as a personal AI agent rather than a chatbot: give it a goal and it breaks the work down, opens web pages, fills forms and calls external apps, handling email, scheduling, bookings or even negotiating a bill. Each user gets a separate Muse Secure VM in Meta's cloud, so tasks keep running after the app is closed and stop only for sensitive approvals. It's US-only for now via a standalone app, web and WhatsApp.

items.title: OpenAI抄袭、威胁数学家？“AI攻克千禧难题”秀，终成 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的大战
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 宣称找到纳维-斯托克斯问题的一个解法，随即陷入争议：纽约大学数学家 Tristan Buckmaster 与受雇于 Anthropic 的 Levent Alpöge 质疑 OpenAI 是否在其接近突破后跟进同方向研究，以及他们上传到 Codex 的草稿和提示词是否被用于模型训练。Buckmaster 还称 OpenAI 提出的发表方案之一是去掉 Alpöge 的署名，Bubeck 与 Sam Altman 先后给出各自版本；两人公开的成果只涉及不可压缩多孔介质方程、Boussinesq 方程和三维不可压缩欧拉方程，并未宣称已解决千禧年难题。
items.summary_en: OpenAI said it had found a solution to the Navier-Stokes problem, and the claim quickly became a dispute: NYU mathematician Tristan Buckmaster and Anthropic-employed researcher Levent Alpöge questioned whether OpenAI started parallel work after learning they were close, and whether drafts and prompts they had fed into Codex were used to train its models. Buckmaster also says OpenAI floated publishing without Alpöge as an author; Sebastien Bubeck and Sam Altman gave their own accounts. The published results cover incompressible porous media, Boussinesq and 3D incompressible Euler equations — not the full Millennium Prize problem.

items.title: 边创作，边评估：纳逗 PRO·剧本空间的多 Agent 实践｜QCon上海

items.title: Tether：在 iOS 与 Linux 桌面电脑之间实现类似 Apple Continuity 的体验
items.summary_zh: 开发者 Zack Bartel 发布开源项目 Tether，在 Linux 桌面复现 Apple Continuity：收发 iMessage 和短信、同步剪贴板、传输文件、查看 iOS 通知，并自动填充一次性验证码。它用双向 TLS 的局域网通信加一套净室实现的 C++ 蓝牙协议栈直接对接 iOS，绕开了在 Mac 上跑代理服务器转发的传统做法，以 MIT 许可发布。
items.summary_en: Developer Zack Bartel released Tether, an open-source project that brings Apple Continuity-style features to Linux desktops: iMessage and SMS, clipboard sync, file transfer, iOS notifications and automatic one-time passcode filling. It relies on mutual TLS over the local network plus a clean-room C++ Bluetooth stack that talks directly to iOS, avoiding the usual Mac-based relay, and ships under the MIT license. One-time codes still need the custom Zen Browser and Betterbird extensions.

items.title: 这个本地模型，让我 token 自由了
items.description: Qwen3.8-27B 把旗舰级 Agent 能力搬进个人电脑，本地运行不花 API 费用，但速度、内存和长任务体验仍有明显门槛。
items.summary_zh: 掘金这篇文章讲的是 Qwen3.8-27B，一个能跑在个人电脑上、不花 API 费用的本地模型，主打把旗舰级 Agent 能力搬到本机。作者也点明代价：速度、内存占用和长任务体验仍有明显门槛，适合愿意折腾本地推理、对响应速度不那么敏感的人。
items.summary_en: The post looks at Qwen3.8-27B, a local model that brings flagship-level agent capability to a personal machine without paying API fees. The author is upfront about the trade-offs: inference speed, memory footprint and long-task experience remain real barriers. It suits developers willing to run local inference who can live with slower responses.

items.title: 《牛来》火了？我用ThreeJs实现了一个简易版的，代码全送给你，文章最后附演示效果
items.description: 最近火了一个电影哈！ 可以说是拳打《蜘蛛侠》，脚踢《龙餐馆》，没错就是这个“土到极致就是潮”的“巨制”——《牛来》 我简单看了一下背景，这个电影据传就俩人的主创...
items.summary_zh: 文章用 Three.js 实现了一个简易版电影《牛来》的效果，并附上完整代码和演示效果。作者提到这部据传仅两人主创的电影因“土到极致就是潮”而走红；适合想借热点练习 Three.js 动画的开发者。
items.summary_en: This post builds a simplified Three.js version of the viral Chinese movie Niu Lai, with the full source code and a demo. The author notes the film is reportedly created by just two people and became popular for its proudly cheesy aesthetics. It's a good starting point for developers learning Three.js through a trending cultural reference.

items.title: 👉 尤雨溪再次成立新公司，同时官宣 Pinia 4 正式发布！
items.description: 尤雨溪出席了 Vue 大会，透露自己成立了新公司 Vue 源码有限公司，用来赞助 Vue 的全职开源成员。此外，它还分享了 Pinia 4 主版本升级，现在只支持 ESM 模块，安装体积大幅缩减。
items.summary_zh: 尤雨溪在 Vue 大会上宣布成立 Vue 源码有限公司，用于资助 Vue 的全职开源成员；同时发布 Pinia 4 主版本，仅支持 ESM 模块，安装体积大幅缩减。Vue 生态开发者需要适配 Pinia 4 的 ESM-only 约束，并了解依赖体积的变化。
items.summary_en: At the Vue conference, You Yuxi announced a new company, Vue Source Co., Ltd., set up to sponsor full-time open-source contributors working on Vue. He also unveiled the Pinia 4 major release, which now supports only ESM modules and shrinks the installed package size significantly. Vue developers should account for the ESM-only constraint.

items.title: 为什么跳槽涨薪 30% 的时代彻底结束了？聊聊 2026 前端薪资的天花板
items.description: 前端薪资红利期结束，供需失衡与AI工具普及压缩执行层价值。高薪转向决策层，需具备成本优化、标准制定或全栈能力。
items.summary_zh: 文章称，前端跳槽涨薪 30% 的红利期已结束，2026 年薪资天花板受到人才供需失衡和 AI 工具普及的双重挤压，执行层价值被压低。高薪机会转向决策层，需要能承担成本优化、标准制定或全栈能力的工程师。适合想评估前端职业空间和技术栈方向的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: The article argues that the era of 30 percent pay raises from job-hopping is over for front-end developers; by 2026 the salary ceiling is squeezed by supply-demand imbalance and AI tools that devalue execution-focused work. Higher-paying roles now go to decision-level engineers who can handle cost optimization, standards, or full-stack work. Good context for developers mapping their front-end career options.

items.summary_zh: 前端开发者“小张同学”结合近期每天用 AI 写代码的体验，分享了一套 AI 全栈开发实践，并坦言手写代码能力已经明显下降。他认为按当前节奏，AI 编写代码会在更多场景替代人工。适合正在搭建 AI 辅助编程流程的开发者参考，也提醒自己别丢掉基本功。
items.summary_en: A front-end developer who goes by “小张同学” shares full-stack development practices built around writing code with AI every day. He admits his hand-coding ability has dropped noticeably and argues AI-generated code will keep replacing manual work in more scenarios. The post is useful for developers building AI-assisted workflows and doubles as a warning about foundational-skills atrophy.
